widgets_values:
Reference sheet: A character and location reference sheet. Character panel 1 shows a blonde woman with an updo, wearing a tight blue mini dress, blue heels, and a pearl choker. Character panel 2 shows a woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a black leather halter top with a keyhole cutout and black leather pants. Character panel 3 shows a woman with short curly black hair, wearing a leopard print mini dress and matching heels. Character panel 4 shows a man with dark hair, wearing a brown leather jacket over a maroon sweater and blue jeans. A location panel shows a grand interior hallway with marble walls featuring brown and grey veining, dark wood doors and trim, wooden flooring, and a gold elevator door set into the marble wall.

Generated video: This scene features the four characters from the reference sheet standing in the marble hallway. The gold elevator doors slide open. The four individuals—the woman in the blue dress, the woman in black leather, the woman in the leopard print dress, and the man in the leather jacket—walk forward and enter the elevator. As they step inside, the camera pans smoothly to center on the front of the elevator doors directly. Once they are fully inside, the gold elevator doors slide shut, closing the scene. The lighting is warm and interior, reflecting off the marble and gold surfaces.

original wf example:

Reference sheet: a clean ingredient reference sheet showing one consistent female Himalayan trekker with medium tan skin, black hair in two long braids, and a calm natural expression. A portrait panel shows her face clearly. A full-body turnaround shows the same woman wearing a muted forest-green short-sleeve hiking T-shirt, beige hiking cargo pants, and brown trekking boots. A gear panel shows a large navy-blue framed hiking backpack with black straps, metal frame supports, and a brown leather patch. A prop panel shows a long natural wooden walking stick. An animal panel shows a white long-haired yak with curved horns and a colorful traditional woven saddle blanket with red, blue, yellow, and patterned details. Location panels show a dramatic Himalayan mountain trail, snow-capped mountains, steep green valleys, and small traditional Himalayan stone houses with white walls, dark wood trim, red doors, and yellow window awnings under a clear blue sky.

Generated video: This scene continues directly from the previous video with the same woman, same braided hair, same muted forest-green hiking T-shirt, beige cargo pants, brown trekking boots, navy-blue framed backpack, wooden walking stick, white long-haired yak, mountain village, lighting, weather, and visual style. The camera begins from the exact composition of the source start frame.

A cinematic eye-level medium-wide shot shows the woman and the yak arriving beside a traditional Himalayan stone house on the mountain path. She slows down, stops near the doorway, and looks toward the house with relief. The yak stands calmly beside her, lightly shifting its weight and moving its long fur in the mountain breeze. The woman adjusts her grip on the wooden walking stick, smiles softly, looks toward the camera, and says, “We made it.” The camera remains steady at the same height and angle with no sudden cut, no vertical drift, no reframing, and no major camera movement. The snowy Himalayan mountains, green valley, prayer flags, and stone village homes remain visible in the background. Natural daylight, gentle wind ambience, quiet yak breathing, and realistic travel-documentary style.
